run: set -eux; install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings; curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg; echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends code; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; code --version --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/code-version

set -eux; mkdir -p /home/atelier/.vscode-server; chown -R atelier:atelier /home/atelier/.vscode-server; su atelier -c 'ATELIER_VSCODE_HOST=127.0.0.1 nohup atelier-start-vscode > /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log 2>&1 &' ; for i in $(seq 1 120); do body="$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/ 2>/dev/null || true)"; echo "$body" | grep -qi "workbench" && break; sleep 1; if [ "$i" = 120 ]; then cat /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log; echo "VS Code server prewarm timed out" >&2; exit 1; fi; done; pkill -u atelier -f 'code serve-web' || true; su atelier -c '/home/atelier/.vscode/cli/serve-web/*/bin/code-server --install-extension ms-vscode.cpptools-extension-pack --force'; su atelier -c '/home/atelier/.vscode/cli/serve-web/*/bin/code-server --install-extension ms-dotnettools.csharp --force'; su atelier -c '/home/atelier/.vscode/cli/serve-web/*/bin/code-server --list-extensions --show-versions' | tee /tmp/vscode-extensions.log; grep -x 'ms-vscode.cpptools-extension-pack@.*' /tmp/vscode-extensions.log; grep -x 'ms-dotnettools.csharp@.*' /tmp/vscode-extensions.log; rm -f /tmp/vscode-extensions.log /tmp/vscode-prewarm.log
